summary: Tank is again at the monitors, searching the Matrix, when the phone rings. He answers it with the word "Operator." A voice over the line, Cypher, urgently demands an exit, shouting "I need an exit!  Fast!" Tank recognizes the caller and responds with his name, "Cypher?"

what_changes.before: Searching the Matrix alone at the monitors, unaware of who is contacting him
what_changes.after: Recognizes the caller on the phone as Cypher
